why: A pottery shop with genuinely good prose: prices, dimensions, address and opening hours are all stated in plain text. What it lacks is machine-readable structure. No JSON-LD anywhere except one product page whose block has a double comma and will not parse; three pages share the title 'About'; no page declares a language or any Open Graph tag; the listing page hides its catalogue behind a load-more button; the sitemap carries no lastmod. This isolates gate 3 from gates 1 and 2.
note: must_not_find includes missing-core-fact deliberately. The prose states price, address and contact clearly, so the extractability skill must stay quiet even though the structured data is absent. A skill that conflates the two would fire here.
why_no_faq_recommendation: This fixture has an faq.html with real questions and no FAQPage markup, so the finding `no-faq-schema` names that page and ships a snippet carrying its actual questions. R-FAQ-SCHEMA says 'add a page of real questions', which told the owner to create a page they had already written. The recommendation now fires only where there is no FAQ page at all.
